name: ai-content-team-os
description: One command that takes today's topic and asks how the Reel gets made - cut the clips you filmed in Higgsfield, or render an AI avatar video in HeyGen Studio - then researches that topic, writes one argument from it in your own voice document's register, and publishes one artifact of nine ready-to-post options: three Instagram with the Reel, three LinkedIn, three X, each scored. Click POST, say "post", and Claude drives your Chrome to publish it. Runs only when you run it; never on a schedule.
